title: x402 Domain & Nonce Window Checker
description: Checks an EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization's domain separation and replay-defense-adjacent fields against caller-supplied expectations. expected_chain_id and expected_verifying_contract are mandatory policy parameters, separate from the chainId/verifyingContract actually baked into the signed domain -- a mismatch on either is a hard refuse, never a soft warning (the cross-domain replay defect EIP-712 domain separation exists to prevent). Also checks the validAfter/validBefore window against a caller-supplied now_unix, and the nonce's format (bytes32, non-zero). Accepts an optional caller-supplied nonce_already_used boolean; this kernel never queries a chain -- on-chain nonce uniqueness is enforced by the token contract at settlement time, not by this verifier. Zero network calls; never a facilitator, proxy, or settlement relay.

expected_chain_id.description: Mandatory policy parameter: the chain id the caller expects this authorization to be valid against. Never defaulted or inferred from the signed domain.

expected_verifying_contract.description: Mandatory policy parameter: the 20-byte hex verifying-contract address the caller expects. Never defaulted or inferred from the signed domain.

chainId.description: The chainId actually baked into the EIP-712 domain the signature was computed against.

verifyingContract.description: The verifyingContract actually baked into the EIP-712 domain the signature was computed against.

now_unix.description: Caller-supplied reference time (uint256 unix timestamp). This kernel never reads the system clock -- the check is a pure function of its inputs.

nonce_already_used.description: Optional: caller-computed boolean against the caller's own on-chain/off-chain record. This kernel never queries a chain.

mcp_tool_definition.name: check_x402_domain_nonce_window
mcp_tool_definition.description: Checks an EIP-3009 authorization's domain (expected vs. signed chainId/verifyingContract, hard refuse on mismatch), validAfter/validBefore window against a caller-supplied now_unix, and nonce format. Accepts an optional caller-supplied nonce_already_used flag. Never queries a chain.
